physical_subject: How can one stored message remain a fair sample of a stream with unknown length?
relationship: At step n, replace with probability 1/n; an old item has chance 1/(n−1) times survival (n−1)/n = 1/n.
operation: One illustrated stream followed by exact probabilities for every possible stored message; compare replacement with survival.
closest_prior: Earlier coin patterns, coupon collection and Pólya urn titles
substantive_difference: Uniform one-item streaming sample via replacement-survival induction; no waiting-time or reinforcement process.
